thread:
Noah: FYI onboarding 'lumina-7b' (Llama->Gemma export then quantized to int4). Short convs look fine, but after ~160 tokens we see a huge increase in token 0 and the model starts repeating. Anyone hit a tokenpack/rotary combo issue?

Rina: What converter + flags? Did you densify ids or emit a remap?

Noah: Used tools/tokenpack.py --pack=int4 --densify. No remap emitted by default. Ran NFKC. Repro excerpt from local run:
```
[2026-03-23T09:12:01Z] INFO step=158 token=301 logp=-3.0
[2026-03-23T09:12:02Z] INFO step=159 token=0 logp=-14.8
[WARN] token 0 spike detected, collapsing output
```

Omar: token 0 spikes almost always point to either pad/EOS aliasing or quant packer collisions when sparse ids are naively remapped into byte lanes. Did the source vocab have invisible or emoji tokens in head slots?

Noah: Yup. Head: ['<pad>','<unk>','\u200B','the',':star:','to','a','\u00A0'] . After densify the invisible ones vanished and ids shifted. I think the packer packed new ids into tight 2-bit lanes without informing the runtime.

Tess: Also check runtime rotary precompute: I remember an optimization that used token_id fingerprinting to reuse precomputed sin/cos per-token in one fast path. If the converter remaps ids mid-sequence, that memoization will return wrong phases and you'll see a sharp logprob drop at the first remapped token.

Rina: Ah yes. We had that bug months ago with a different exporter. Two root causes here: (1) densify w/o remap leads quant packer to alias sparse->dense ids into the same byte representation as pad, (2) rotary/token-identity based cache assumes id stability.

Noah: Re-ran with fixed flow: tokenpack --densify=false --emit-remap=remap.json and loader passed remap.json at load. Also disabled token-id memoization fallback in runtime. Validation PPL: baseline=11.9, densify-no-remap=28.7, remap+no-densify=12.1. Problem gone.

Omar: Nice. Actionables: 1) change tokenpack default to emit remap.json and not densify unless --force-densify. 2) Add a converter lint that fails if any invisible/control/emoji token would be relocated into pad/unk/eos slots. 3) Add a runtime assertion: if remap.json missing and model contains non-contiguous ids or remapped ranges exceed quant packer assumptions, fail to load with clear error. 4) Remove token-id-based rotary memo fast-path or make it use position index instead.

Tess: Also add an eval: run longctx_repro up to 512 tokens with 3 seeds, sliding-window mean logp delta vs baseline, fail if delta >0.4. And add a small binary test that detects token 0 spikes in output >3% of tokens for long prompts.

Noah: I'll open the PR with: tokenpack defaults updated, remap emitter, converter-lint, longctx_repro test, packer validation in runtime, and docs note in onboarding/compat.md about "packers vs remap".

ci-bot: build 3032 queued for tokenpack on branch onboard/lumina-remap :gear:

ops-bot: scheduling 12h canary run on dedicated pool eu-west-1, task id c-5592

Rina: Quick doc note: rotary-scale fiddles can sometimes hide the symptom early by smoothing phase mismatch but they don't fix aliasing. Add that warning near the rotary section.

Noah: Will include. Tagging Omar/Tess for review. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
summary: lumina-7b onboarding: densify/pack without remap caused quant aliasing and token-id-based rotary memoization to fail; fixed by emitting remap, disabling densify, and adding lints/tests
